authoring.value:
First, let's write the system so that $x$, $y$, and $z$ appear in each equation:

$$
{\begin{aligned}6x+4y+0z=1 \\ x-8y-z=-2 \\ 3x+2y-2z=1\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we can write the system in the form $A\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{b},$ where

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14052721/assets/b9364923447e278db5ec47bef74e1a05310645b30df22d4ea5efcc0de46c6ed2.png)

is the coefficient matrix,

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14052721/assets/16cb1608f70821d138f0c6984038bb42d86d9fbf76d560d94d2e25bd6fdb05e0.png)

is the column vector of constants, and

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14052721/assets/0abbbaf34955fa40d6cdbfa9e16cb1567ee16271d65b4565206a0f2204eedf6d.png)

is the column vector of variables.

So, the equation $A\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{b}$ becomes

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14052721/assets/4b915439c3e9922d692aab4205a728160e0a1286f82fa5ebc736460901581147.png)

Therefore, $a=6,$ $b=2,$ and $c=-2.$

$$

$$

Now, we can write the system in the form $A\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{b},$ where

is the column vector of constants, and

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14052721/assets/c85e33202a691b685431ac16efab6a7fd932eac056743df6e81632587f0465b2.png)

is the column vector of variables.

So, the equation $A\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{b}$ becomes

Therefore $a=0,$ $b=-2,$ $c=-3.$
